text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Gaaahhh! Defeated... Trounced... I
totally lost!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: No... no! I can't take it! I have to be the world's hella strongest! I need to be!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: El...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...But I'll accept my own weakness.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And I admit that you're incredibly
powerful, Spe!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: El!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Let us shake hands, amiga. I can bear the

humiliation of defeat as long as we
congratulate
each other.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'm glad I got to race against you!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I mean, yeah! Me too, El!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two exchange a firm handshake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then, on the way back home...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Great job at the Japan Cup, Spe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Grass! Did you see me race?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Of course I did! I was watching intently
from the
stands.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for you here ever since
then.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Waiting for me? But why? Wait, you
don't mean...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I know quite well how strong El is.
Calling herself
the world's strongest isn't
just her ego talking.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And yet you bested her, Spe. Fair and
square.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No one can doubt how strong you've
become
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: And thus, I would like to challenge you as well.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
As a kindred spirit who shares the goal
of making
it to the end of the journey
we call a "race."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Grass!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Our fated battle shall take place at the
Arima
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The race where only the most resilient
classic and
senior year Umamusume with
enough votes get to
participate.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Let us determine who will reign supreme,
Spe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just like that, Special Week finds herself
a rival
to race against in the Arima
Kinen—the Beast,
Grass Wonder.
